body:
Triage: lands in `scripts/check-cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` (gate tooling) ⇒ `domain:devx`, `pm:queue`, type Task. Rationale: silent-by-construction staleness limb gap, reachable today (measured ablation on plugin-auth), direction A is well-specified and symmetric with the existing roster check — a scoped gate repair, no design escalation. Serial constraint for dispatch: open PR #10450 holds the file; land after it, not as a rider.

- Folded with #10565 — same file, one PR.

**Serial constraint cleared.** Both cards say PR #10450 holds
`scripts/check-cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` and must land first. #10450 merged
**2026-08-21T04:53:22Z**, so the file is free.

**Re-verified on `origin/main` = `55809a09a52734c8a26bc5186359f4ce3050deba`** (fetched
2026-08-21T08:28:14Z), not on the cards' `ceb33a9f12`: `verify()` is at `:1238` and still
has exactly three limbs — the two package-scoped staleness limbs (`:1243-1254`,
`:1255-1262`) and the per-*literal* coverage loop (`:1266-1281`). **No limb asks whether a
declared glob is still held by anything.** The gap this card describes is present at the
current tip.

Dispatching direction **A**, built as the inverse of `:1266-1281` and reading the same
data (`info.literals` / `info.dirEntries`, `coversDirectory()` / `matchesAny()`) — the
roster, **never the filesystem**, since the globs declared for prose-named paths
(`serve.ts`, `check-nul-bytes.mjs`, `realtime-protocol.mdx`) are held by the flat literal
collector and an fs-based check would red all three.
